key_insight: WorkoutCPP is a pilot N-of-1 trial program testing whether reinforcement learning can personalize exercise advice for chronic pelvic pain day by day.
clinical_relevance: If feasible, this approach could better match exercise recommendations to symptom variability in chronic pelvic pain disorders than fixed programs.
method: 45 participants aged 18-55 with chronic pelvic pain disorders
9-week N-of-1 ABAB or BABA design: 1 baseline week plus four 2-week alternating phases
Compare generic exercise guidance vs RL-generated adaptive recommendations delivered through the ehive app
evidence_signal: The study is a protocol, so the abstract reports planned feasibility and safety evaluation rather than results, with adherence and retention as primary outcomes.
watch_item: This is an early pilot with no efficacy data yet, so usability, safety, and real-world adherence remain uncertain.
paper_title: Protocol: WorkoutCPP - a pilot series of N-of-1 trials evaluating RL-generated adaptive exercise recommendations for pelvic pain management
